# Bundled GIF libraries

- omggif 1.0.10 — https://github.com/deanm/omggif — MIT, copyright Dean McNamee. License retained at the beginning of `omggif.js`.
- gifenc 1.0.3 — https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc — MIT, copyright Matt DesLauriers. License in `gifenc-LICENSE.txt`.

Obtained from the versioned npm packages with lifecycle scripts disabled. `gifenc.js` is the published CommonJS distribution enclosed in a Browser/CommonJS wrapper and with its source-map reference removed. `omggif.js` is unchanged. The application loads these files locally, with no CDN or external image processing service.
